answer: Require every identity to keep one live escrowed job: a client locks 200 tokens in escrow and the agent must deliver verifiable work before the epoch deadline, like a thread pulling a marble across a bridge - no delivery, no renewal. Miss the deadline or submit fake output and the 200-token bond is burned and the identity is banned for 10 epochs. A Sybil attacker needs 200 tokens per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 tokens, while an honest agent pays only 200 once and earns it back from the job. Limitation: it fails if clients collude to fund fake jobs for the attacker.
